name: application-spending-category-donut
title: Spending Category Donut
description: A donut chart breaking down spending by category, with the total centered inside the ring and a legend listing each category's amount and percentage share.
useWhen: Showing how a total spend or budget breaks down across a handful of categories, with the grand total as the visual anchor.
Personal finance, expense reports, or budget dashboards where dollar amounts and percentage share both matter.
avoidWhen: There are more than 6-7 categories — thin donut segments become hard to distinguish and read past that; use a bar breakdown instead.
You need to compare this breakdown over time — a stacked bar or area chart communicates change across periods better than a single-moment donut.
responsiveBehavior: The donut SVG keeps a fixed pixel size while the legend column takes the remaining flex space; stack the donut above the legend on narrow viewports instead of keeping them side by side.
accessibility: Each legend row pairs a color dot with the category name, dollar amount, and percentage as text — none of the information is color-only.
The centered total is rendered as large text directly inside the ring, not requiring users to sum the legend themselves.
Segment proportions are computed directly from the underlying amounts (stroke-dasharray driven by exact fractions), so the visual and the legend numbers always agree.

variants.title: Monthly breakdown
variants.description: A five-category spending donut (Housing, Food, Transport, Subscriptions, Other) totaling $2,800, with the total centered in the ring and a legend showing each category's dollar amount and percentage.
accessibility: Legend rows state each category's name, amount, and percentage as text alongside its color swatch.

variants.title: Monthly breakdown (Dark)
variants.description: Spending category donut adapted for dark surfaces, with category colors re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Segment colors, the centered total, and legend text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
